description: The businessman spent nearly every summer in the seasonal South of France hotspot for the fashion and luxury industries. Just as in Paris, where he owned an apartment, this town – frequented by celebrities, billionaires and aspiring models – served as a base for his sexual crimes.

headline: France's Night of the Stars 2026: Everything to know about the stargazing event
description: This weekend, nearly 500 stargazing gatherings are set to take place across France. This year's theme is the Sun, which will experience a partial eclipse over mainland France and Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, caused by the Moon, on August 12.

headline: Despite success of Tour de France Femmes, fears of a two-tier women's cycling
description: While the sport has become significantly more professional since the return of the Tour in 2022, some in the sector worry that this rapid growth is leaving behind teams and riders who are not part of the elite.

headline: A fragile enclave in Colombia offers shelter from armed group violence
description: 'Growing up in hostile environments' (1/7). Photographer Louisa Ben traveled to the port city of Buenaventura, Colombia, long plagued by armed group violence. She opens the doors to the stilt houses of the so-called 'peace zone,' a neighborhood protected by police and soldiers but whose fragile safety has been shaken since the recent election of a far-right president backed by Donald Trump.

headline: Alexander McQueen and Isabella Blow: Fashion, friendship and tragedy
description: 'Sewn and torn' (1/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. In the mid-1990s, an almost symbiotic relationship developed between the London-born designer from a working-class background and the broke aristocratic fashion journalist. That bond shattered when McQueen left for Givenchy, marking the end of their closeness – something neither ever truly recovered from.

headline: The Golden Owl, the treasure hunt that drives you mad: 'No one listens to anyone anymore'
description: 'The Golden Owl's last secrets' (1/6). Thirty-one years after it was buried, the treasure known as La Chouette d'Or, or Golden Owl, was discovered on the night of October 2, 2024. Yet, many 'chouetteurs' – the name given to the community of treasure hunters obsessed with this elusive statuette – never stopped searching for 'the real one.' Something doesn't add up.
